title: Vtg Safeway America's Favorite Food Store Matchbook Full Unstruck Margarine Red
descriptionText: This vintage matchbook features advertising for Safeway, America's Favorite Food Store, promoting margarine. It is full and unstruck, with a red cover. Made in the United States, this collectible item is a piece of nostalgia from the past.
